text: Over the last 30 days, visitors have noted issues related to food quality and wait times at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Four reviews mentioned food quality, and three mentioned wait times, indicating these areas may need attention. Service was mentioned in two reviews, while atmosphere was noted once. Overall, the average rating remains high with no critical reviews during this period.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days show consistent concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was frequently backed up and only grab-and-go options were offered late in the day. Many found the food quality lacking, describing items as overpriced, small in portion, or poorly prepared. There were also complaints about the menu choices being limited and not meeting expectations. Service issues and value for money were additional points raised by multiple visitors.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about portion sizes, pricing, and preparation. Service problems were noted, including long wait times and periods when the kitchen was not taking orders. While the library itself receives positive comments, the café’s offerings and operations need attention to improve visitor satisfaction.
